description:
Get Google Gemini Answer

Sends a prompt to Google Gemini anonymously and returns the markdown answer plus cited web sources (domain, title, snippet, cited text, favicon), inline images (source page, thumbnail, alt), the detected model, answer language, whether a web search ran, and a subsequentRequestToken. The answer language follows the prompt and hl. Pass the subsequentRequestToken from a previous answer to continue that conversation; omit it to start fresh. Use for cited answers, RAG grounding, AI-visibility monitoring or model-answer datasets.

hl.description: Interface language for the answer, as a BCP-47 locale such as `en-US` or `de-DE`. The answer language also follows the language of the prompt.

prompt.description: The question or instruction to send to Google Gemini, up to 8000 characters. A prompt that asks about recent events makes Gemini search the web and return sources; a general-knowledge prompt is answered from the model alone. The prompt also decides the language of the answer — write it in the language you want back, or ask for one explicitly.

subsequentRequestToken.description: Token returned in a previous answer as `subsequentRequestToken`. Pass it back to continue that conversation, so Gemini answers the new prompt with the earlier turns in context. Omit it to start a fresh conversation.
